activity.role: Secretary-General of the General People's Congress
activity.notes: On 2 March 1977 Libya's new Jamahiriya political order replaced the Revolutionary Command Council structure, and Gaddafi became Secretary-General of the General People's Congress. He relinquished this formal governmental post on 2 March 1979. ATLAS records this formal 1977-1979 office separately from his later extra-constitutional revolutionary leadership.

sources.title: Libya: A Country Study — Library of Congress / Federal Research Division
sources.citation_text: The country study states that the GPC proclaimed the Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya in March 1977, designated Gaddafi its general secretary, and that he relinquished his formal governmental position in 1979.

sources.title: Libya — Law Library of Congress
sources.citation_text: The Law Library of Congress explains that the 1977 structure placed Qadhafi at the head of the GPC General Secretariat as Secretary-General and treated that office as the practical head-of-state position.
